chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) did not have a full meal of wheat bread for three days, until he passed away.
ai.seo_question: What was the dietary habit of the Prophet regarding wheat bread and fasting?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (a.s.) highlights the Prophet’s enduring asceticism (zuhd) by noting that he often went three days without consuming wheat bread, a staple of comfort, until his passing. This tradition underscores the Prophet’s voluntary simplicity and his identification with the poor, serving as a key model for Shia spiritual discipline and leadership humility.
